summary:
Node.js’s site is nodejs.org. The green hexagon in the tab is the icon docs bookmarks use, separate from npm’s red hexagon.

Checked 12 November 2026 against nodejs.org. HTML came from https://nodejs.org/en (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://nodejs.org/static/images/favicons/favicon.png.

No favicon.ico URL returned an image on 12 November 2026. nodejs.org did not pass the image check for an .ico path. Formats that did save: png.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #55aa44 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-32x32-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-32x32-01.png at 32×32 (png, 1130 bytes) from https://nodejs.org/static/images/favicons/favicon.png.
